title: lgd-world-map
revision_note: 1.1: added identity_layers / counts / verify / license blocks, added LGD, agent-skills and assayance entry points, and dropped a stale count carried in 1.0. Every number in this file is meant to be re-checkable, not aspirational. 1.2 (2026-11-21): the Rekor block now states the inclusion proof as verified, records its own correction of a false negative, and lists what inclusion still does not prove (equivocation, cross-shard consistency, entry.logIndex semantics); consistency between two signed heads of the active tree is now verified too.

counts.skills_curated_note: human-curated subset of the 119; not machine-derivable, so read it as a curation statement rather than a computable count
counts.domain_papers_note: 13 papers numbered #1-#14; the missing number is #11, which is MED-001 (unpublished). The 12 domain codes are AUT/BIO/CRYPT/DAT/EDU/FIN/GOV/IND/LAW/MED/ROB/UAS; FIN and MED each carry two papers (FIN-001/002, MED-002), which is why 12 codes yield 13 papers.
counts.badge_note: 16 directions x EN/CN = 32 SVGs; badge count is not paper count
counts.verification_note: Recomputed on 2026-11-24 at uibc-core HEAD 9dfd714be03bbf305ee35906179d78b05ed327e2. `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"` -> Ran 1156 tests, 1 failure + 1 error, 8 skipped (355.8 s), and `python -m pytest tests -q` -> 2 failed, 1553 passed, 12 skipped, 118 subtests passed (484.25 s); both runs on Windows 11, Python 3.13.18, with `.[verify,interop,conformance]` installed. The three non-passes are the same subprocess spawns that need a POSIX shell and are green on the Linux CI matrix (test 3.10-3.13, HEAD 9dfd714, 21/21 checks). The 858 in the previous note was measured 2026-11-20 without the extras; the delta is new tests plus the extras path, not a correction of the old figure. pytest and unittest counts are different calibers (parameterisation and subtests) - compare like with like. skills (119) and silent-failure patterns (16) were re-derived on 2026-11-24 from agent-skills/contents/skills (directory count) and silent-failure-catalog/failures/patterns.json (count field).

layers.scope: sole author of the texts referenced here

layers.name: SynomosAI Governance Line

identity_layers.topics_note: GitHub topics 'synomosai' and 'medxpert' are discoverability labels. They assert no legal entity and no trademark right.

In-repo copyright footers that named the initiative in the (c) position were corrected to the person on 2026-10-22.

swh_archive.scope_note: A SWHID identifies content that existed in that snapshot. Per the SWHID specification the origin qualifier gives no guarantee of retrieval success, because an origin can change or disappear. Read this as archival evidence, not as an availability promise.
swh_archive.correction: An earlier README cited visit 2558384, which does not exist for this origin; corrected 2026-10-22.

can_prove: a private key signed this sha256 digest

this entry is included in the tree the log signed: the RFC 9162 inclusion path folds the entry's leaf to the checkpoint's root, and the checkpoint's ECDSA P-256 signature verifies against the log's published key
cannot_prove: who the signer is - the entry carries no identity binding
which file or version the digest belongs to - the entry carries no filename or version
that the log never signed a conflicting tree - a valid signature is not an equivocation audit
consistency across shards - Rekor lists inactive shards with their own tree ids, and this portal does not claim the active tree extends any shard's tree
rekor.pipeline_status: the repo's automated build-provenance workflow was failing as of 2026-10-18 (the attestation step lacked the attestations: write permission); a fix is prepared and not yet merged, so this log entry is a historical manual item rather than output of a working pipeline
rekor.log_id_method: SHA-256 of the log's DER public key (the Sigstore definition of logID); recomputable from https://rekor.sigstore.dev/api/v1/log/publicKey
rekor.tree_id_note: value returned by /api/v1/log as treeID; independently recomputed by two reviewers on 2026-10-22 and confirmed equal. It also happens to equal the first 8 bytes of this entry's UUID — noted so a reader who notices is not confused; it is a tree identifier, not an identity claim.
rekor.kind_note: the value is read from the entry body (body.kind); the entries API returns entry.kind = null at the top level, so a reader checking entry.kind will see null and may think the field is missing

inclusion_proof.proof_tree_size: read from the entry at verification time (the log grows, so this number is not pinned here)
inclusion_proof.root_hash: read from the entry at verification time; equality with the checkpoint's root line is checked, not asserted here
inclusion_proof.checkpoint_signature: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the three checkpoint text lines; key id c0d23d6a
inclusion_proof.reproduce: python tools/verify_rekor_inclusion.py --log-index 2883389783 (uibc-core; verifies leaf, path, root and checkpoint signature)
inclusion_proof.correction: this portal previously carried 'the inclusion proof does not verify, by our reading or by a third party's'. That was wrong and it was our error: the leaf is SHA-256(0x00 || body bytes) (we hashed the body first and hashed the digest again), and the path must be folded against verification.inclusionProof.logIndex, which differs from entry.logIndex. Full account: uibc-core docs/REKOR-INCLUSION-2026-11-21.md
inclusion_proof.third_party_check: the same tool, unchanged, verifies an entry from dfr.derappar.at (uuid 108e9186...439bd6b455165f1e02), so the defect was in the reading and not in the log
inclusion_proof.entry_log_index_note: entry.logIndex (2883389783) and verification.inclusionProof.logIndex (2761485521) are different numbers for this entry. The proof is only checkable against the index it carries; we record the top-level difference without asserting what it means

consistency.note: both heads signed under rekor.sigstore.dev - 1193050959916656506 and both signatures verified; sizes are a point-in-time pair, not a pinned claim, because the log keeps growing
consistency.reproduce: python tools/verify_rekor_inclusion.py --consistency --from <receipt.json> (uibc-core; folds the consistency proof with the RFC 6962 algorithm ported from transparency-dev/merkle proof/verify.go)
